summary: Implemented REG-FR-02 app-name derivation, sanitization, override validation, and collision detection in src/config/name.ts with 38 focused tests; typecheck, lint, focused tests, full unit suite (202), and build all pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented REG-FR-02 app-name derivation, sanitization, override validation, and collision detection in src/config/name.ts with 38 focused tests; typecheck, lint, focused tests, full unit suite (202), and build all pass.
decisions: Purely numeric names are rejected only during derivation as ambiguous; explicit --name values are accepted when they match the documented pattern.
Reserved-looking names such as CON, NUL, config, apps, and doctor are allowed because the PRD defines no reserved list and the target is Linux/Podman.
Collision checks validate the name before path joining so they cannot be used for traversal.
interfaces: sanitizeAppName, repositoryBasename, deriveAppName, validateAppName, isValidAppName, isAmbiguousAppName, resolveAppName, appNameExists, assertAppNameAvailable
resolveAppName supports both (source, override) and { source, name }
warnings: Collision detection is a read-only pre-check; the allocation lock from REG-1.4 is still required to close the check-to-create race.
payload.taskDescription: Implement name derivation and validation. Lowercase the repository basename, replace runs of characters outside a-z0-9 with a single hyphen, trim hyphens, truncate to 32 characters, and reject an empty result or a result starting with a digit-only segment when it would be ambiguous. Accept an override and validate it against the same pattern. Detect an existing app directory and return a conflict error. Tests cover GitHub and GitLab URLs with .git suffixes, scp-style SSH URLs, local paths, unicode, reserved-looking names, over-long names, and collisions.
